name: modscope
description: A mod for debugging other mods: load-order registry, per-event mod attribution, error capture, bypass/bisect, and replay export.

trace_max.title: Trace depth
trace_max.description: How many recent dispatches the in-memory trace ring keeps.

trace_api_calls.title: Trace $ API calls
trace_api_calls.description: Also trace noisy $ op calls (fs, store, env, model, clock, ...). Toggle at runtime with '/modscope verbose'.

redact.title: Redact secrets
redact.description: Mask token/secret-looking keys and token-shaped strings in recorded payloads.

blocklist.title: Blocked mods
blocklist.description: Mod names refused at plugin.register (user tier only). Also managed at runtime via '/modscope block'.
